_comment_baseUrl: No trailing slash, and no www -- this is the canonical origin every page declares. Every canonical, Open Graph URL, sitemap entry, schema @id and robots.txt line is built from it. Must match the CNAME file at the repo root.
_comment_googleSiteVerification: This token belongs to the old thekicker.github.io Search Console property and will NOT verify fiesta-color-guide.com. Either paste the token for the new property here, or verify the domain by DNS TXT record (which covers every subdomain and survives template changes) and set this to "".
_comment_adsense: Two independent stages. Setting `client` puts the AdSense loader script and the google-adsense-account meta tag in the head of every page and writes ads.txt -- that is what site verification and Auto ads need, and it is all you need before approval. Filling in a `slots` entry additionally renders that manual <ins> unit in its reserved box; leave a slot empty and nothing is emitted for it. To turn everything off, clear `client`.
